summary.text: Jamie Long is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 61B, where Ballotpedia lists the current tenure as beginning in 2019, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists no other candidate in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Long served as state House Majority Leader from January 2023 to February 2025; following a power-sharing agreement between House DFL and Republican leaders in February 2025, he became House DFL Floor Leader. His 2025-2026 committee assignments included co-chairing the Rules and Legislative Administration Committee.
